column3: “prepare the roads” renders “establish the way”; “as a possession” renders “as an inheritance.”
“kills his friend unintentionally” renders “strikes his companion without knowledge”; “previously” renders “from yesterday and the third day.”
“the iron head slips off the handle” renders “the iron slips off from the wood.”
“in the heat of his anger” renders “for his heart is hot”; “take his life” renders “strike him, life.”
“carefully observe” renders “keep … to do it”; “always” renders “all the days.”
“bloodguiltiness be on you” renders “bloods be on you”; the Hebrew has no negative before this clause.
“You shall not pity him” renders “your eye shall not pity him.”
“on the evidence of” renders “on the mouth of”; “confirmed” renders “stand.”
“malicious witness” renders “witness of violence”; “wrongdoing” renders “rebellion” or “apostasy.”
“you shall not show pity” renders “your eye shall not pity.”
